//: The quality spike's Park, one design shared by all three techniques. Metres; one grounds place is a 12 m square. Axes: x east, y north, z up; the town hall's grounds scale from it. The camera looks from the south-east corner (x+, y-) at the SVG scene's 2:1 isometric angle, so north-west is the back of the picture. Light (WS10 art direction, 6 Nov): sun from the west-south-west, the camera's left (azimuth ~250°, elevation ~35°), so the near-left faces are lit as in the SVG mock and shadows fall back-right. Not north-west as on the top-down map: from this camera that leaves every visible face in shade.
